verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents person tracking that records which users are affected by each error. It works automatically in Rails and Django, so affected-user impact is available per item. However, the only session evidence is session replay (beta) and a session quota on the pricing page, not per-issue counts of affected sessions. Nothing shows users being able to sort or prioritize issues by blast radius instead of occurrence counts. Missing for 10: per-issue affected-session counts, documented sorting/prioritization by affected users, independent corroboration of the impact metrics.
